t: A slim eight-core Linux computer with fast networking and an AI chip.
steps: Buy the board from the Banana Pi shop or the ArmSoM store, where it is called the Sige7.
Get a USB-C PD charger that supplies 9, 12, or 15 V. Plug it into the port marked PD.
Add a heatsink and fan to keep the chip cool.
Download the Armbian image for the BPI-M7 from the Banana Pi docs.
Flash the image to a microSD card with a free flashing app.
Boot the board with a monitor, keyboard, and Ethernet cable attached.
Run a system update and try a simple Python script.
Explore the RKNN toolkit examples to test the AI chip.
